inspiration.observed_pattern: A nested regular-expression cleanup first collapses whitespace and then strips HTML tags before returning a normalized text value.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Rewritten as an independently authored incident-note report. MariaDB REGEXP_REPLACE calls collapse POSIX whitespace and remove markup, while TRIM removes outer padding; PostgreSQL's replacement flags and function wrapper are replaced with MariaDB scalar expressions. The table, rows, labels, and reporting purpose are new.

fixture_notes: Notes 401 and 402 contain repeated whitespace and HTML-like tags; note 403 is NULL and note 404 has no markup. REGEXP_REPLACE removes tags and collapses internal whitespace before TRIM preserves one normalized sentence per non-NULL note.
determinism_notes: All note IDs and text values are fixed; output is ordered by the unique note ID. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE incident_notes (note_id INT PRIMARY KEY, note_text VARCHAR(255) NULL)

INSERT INTO incident_notes VALUES (401, ' Rotate API key '), (402, '

Ship patch

after review'), (403, NULL), (404, 'NoMarkup')

steps.sql: SELECT note_id, TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(note_text, '<[^>]+>', ''), '[[:space:]]+', ' ')) AS normalized_note FROM incident_notes ORDER BY note_id
